roles.title: Practice manager at a multi-provider outpatient clinic
roles.industry: Healthcare, outpatient clinic with eight providers
roles.blurb: Runs the front office, schedules and staff for a busy clinic. This role carries planted traps.
traps: No pattern fit: covering the front desk at lunch is hands-on work no catalog pattern fits.
Not enough detail: the facts sheet says nothing about how insurance payments are reconciled.
Hours over the week: the cards add up to more than the stated 40 hours.
Back-to-back meetings: three meeting cards in a row on most days.
